entries.message: Scrolling in Settings and switching between the top bar and sidebar address bar, opening the command palette, hiding or docking the sidebar, and showing Recent Tabs now animate smoothly at up to 120 fps.
Picture in Picture no longer jumps or pushes away from display edges while resizing, and flies cleanly into place without blocking input.

Dragging tabs in scrolled and large sidebar lists keeps the floating pickup preview aligned under the pointer and smoothly moves surrounding tabs and drop slots out of the way while preserving 120 fps scrolling.
